summary: build-to-learn spike over the live tree: the literal named-in-prose reading of block-to-prose reports 97 fields, almost all glossed conventional ones; the explained reading reports 29 bare path fields in comma-list Input lines. Prose-to-block reports 5: three definitions mandate a BLOCKER their Output block omits (the issue's exact class) and two name another agent's field on purpose.

detail: spec-judge round 1 returned blocked at pre-flight: the declared spec-producer set omitted lifecycle and gate-validation, two fixed-universal governances the spec gate requires. Loaded both and re-dispatched. Second occurrence of this pre-flight miss in the ledger, so the off-enum value is flagged as an enum-growth candidate.

spec-judge round 2 failed builder and architect: two dead-edge scenarios (list-item declaration hidden by the skip rule; singular form not a known field), an unguarded gloss boundary, an ambiguous Given in the one-run scenario, and key terms disagreeing with the CFG on the vocabulary source and comma-list gloss. Swept the rule (every stated parse rule needs an edge that can register a miss): added six scenarios, fixed both dead edges and the ambiguous Given, restated the key terms to match the CFG, and pinned the remaining parse details in implementation tests.

spec-judge round 3 failed builder and architect. Two findings named scenarios added in round 2 (the plural-suffix and comma-list-gloss scenarios were dead against a reader that fails to recognize the form, hidden by the skip rule), so the round is a regression by provenance and the default cap of 3 was reached. Re-planned rather than patched: every declaration-form scenario now carries an independently recognized declaration plus a mandate or finding only correct recognition clears, verified by a mutation sweep of eleven wrong readers, each killed by its intended scenario. Rewrote the CFG so every parse outcome loops back to the next line and converges on the vocabulary. Added scenarios for the list-item own-line rule, the lone-token rule, the end-of-block gloss boundary and the symmetric same-field direction. Operator notified of running past the cap.

summary: mission restarted from intake under the sdd 0.4.0 start-mission: entry-set governances loaded and declared up front, owner grilled live, dispatch routed through the cyberlegion dispatch governance; the first attempt's draft and its judge rounds are kept as reference only

explore spike: every draft scenario satisfiable, live tree clean, nineteen-rule mutation sweep with no survivor; surfaced two gaps — a lone token opening a block was unstated (stated in key terms, same outcome as its sibling scenario) and a list item's gloss was excluded from prose, leaving mandates there unscanned (prose narrowed to exclude only the bold lead, one scenario added)

detail: spec-judge round 1 of the restarted loop failed builder: the whole-word rule had no acceptance edge, and the note deferring it to implementation tests misapplied the collapse rule. Substantiated by a substring mutant that survived every acceptance scenario. Swept every key-terms clause by mutation: frontmatter-not-prose, the two-character token floor, the marker's own-line scope, the opens-with mandate rule, comment-as-gloss and the two deferred discovery locations also survived. Removed the deferral note, added six scenarios, widened the not-a-definition scenario to a convergence over all three non-definition locations. Line-ending handling ruled out as an unstated invariant. Provenance pre-existing: the deferral note predates this loop.
